subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
THE UNION RE-SWEEP: NINE BYTE-EXACT CLOSES, project matched 64.71% -> 65.61% (2691 -> 2700 functions), Game Code 56.37% -> 57.49%. Every verdict is webfrank.apply_patch's own residual against the extracted retail object; nothing is simulated, and the derivation is validated by canaries before any candidate is trusted.

CANARIES FIRST, AND TWO OF THEM FAILED USEFULLY. The searcher was required to independently rediscover every known composed close before being pointed at anything new: dcs::update_chinfo, camera::camera_mode_level, btext::DrawGlowTextMLines, pb_diag::pbResetDiag, select::init_player_change, pb_texture::pbInitTlutRegions, pb_window::pbProjCalc, sfx::StartThrowMagicFX -- 8/8 pass, across pre- and post-placements and single- and multi-window rules, reproducing camera_mode_level's shipped before/after hashes exactly. The two initial failures are the value of the exercise. (1) update_chinfo returned ZERO candidate sources for a destination because relocations were keyed by RAW offset; claim.law.HV_emb-sda21-relocation-offset-differs-...v1 predicted precisely this (EMB_SDA21 sits at instruction+2 in MWCC output and instruction+0 in the target), and keying by WORD fixed it. A lane's own law caught its own defect one call after it was written. (2) DrawGlowTextMLines was refused by a window screen that rejected any window CONTAINING an lmw/stmw -- copied from HA's ha_widen. That screen is unsound-by-coarseness in the discipline-14 sense: an lmw that only MOVES needs no register field changed, and the finer shape check already forces it onto a byte-identical lmw. Removing the coarse screen closed the function. HB's screen-3 fix and this are the same defect from two sides.

THE SCREEN-3 FIX PAYS IMMEDIATELY AND VISIBLY. Testing the UNWIDENED cluster first found update_chinfo's window as [0x6c,0x74) order [1,0] where the SHIPPED rule uses [0x68,0x78) order [0,2,1,3]. Both close; the narrower one is the one a widen-first search cannot reach.

THE ROSTER. 142 equal-size, differing, UNSHIPPED functions outside the six TUs other lanes own this run: tier A 10, tier B 132. Closes 9. TIER A 2/10 -- controls::MtapOpenPort (83i, combined-stage constant_dataflow_recolor at +0xac) and tower::TowerCheckMessages (697i, real 122 -> 0, the first shipped member of the register-field-only repair class, see claim.law.HV_a-register-field-only-permutation-repairs-a-non-bijective-recolor-...v1). TIER B 7/132 -- enemy::fn_8004646C (133i, real 72), newcam::fn_8006DF34 (378i, real 24, permute+form+recolor with a relocated window), camera::camera_mode_target (452i, real 24, POST-recolor permutation), movieplayer::__ct__11MoviePlayerFv (25i, permutation only, NO register stage), critter::CritterLineRootColSub (174i, real 42, a TEN-atom window plus three copy->copy form sites), mb_font::MBRenderText (347i, real 22, post-recolor permutation at EXACTLY the offsets its own park named), movieplayer::fn_800D91B4 (136i, real 136, recovered from the guard crash). 310 + 136 = 446 real diffs closed.

THE REFUSAL TAXONOMY, 133 refusals with the bar named. 92 'no window+order passes the full guard chain' -- the honest residue; the cluster admits no reordering that survives dependences, recolor and bisimulation jointly. 29 refused on MY OWN cluster bound at the first pass; the bound was raised from 3 to 8 and ALL 29 RE-RUN, and 0 of 29 close. That is a clean negative worth more than the bound: the multi-cluster tail (4 to 46 clusters, up to DoPlayerAction at 1765 instructions) holds nothing for this family, and a later lane should NOT re-derive it. 4 'renaming inconsistent, no repair window found'. 4 'base register presence differs (g0 vs gNN)' -- the permanent bar CH already named. 5 aborted by a shipped-guard crash and re-run (see claim.law.HV_a-guard-that-crashes-while-formatting-its-refusal-...v1).

THREE PARKED RECORDS DISSOLVED BY CONSTRUCTION. mb_font::MBRenderText's park (attempt.parked.mbrendertext-color-tiebreak.20260901.v4, four source-axis versions) names 'an r0<->r3 colour tie-break at +0x108..+0x130'; the shipped window is EXACTLY [0x108,0x130). movieplayer::__ct__11MoviePlayerFv is a THIRD member of the mp-label-correction family dissolved by closure, after the three my run-27 lane dissolved -- a permutation reproducing the target bytes is a constructive disproof of a STRUCTURAL label, and that family should now be treated as unscreened rather than parked. Every park on all nine functions is SOURCE-axis; not one claimed postprocessor ineligibility, so none was a veto on this axis and all are upheld as source caps.

CONSEQUENCE FOR TRIAGE. HB's verdict that permutation composition, not the combined stage, is the live axis is CONFIRMED and extended: 7 of 9 closes are permutation compositions and only 2 touch the combined stage. But the sharper finding is that the axis with the closes was the one NO census measured -- the Tier-A refusals. The payoff inversion recurs a fifth time, now inverting the census itself rather than the ranking inside it: the functions a census files as 'already served by copy_register_fields, and refusing' are the ones with unharvested exacts in them.
